Feb 2026 • Couples
The interior of this restaurant is very modern and trendy with lots of clientele taking photos for social media while we were there.

The staff accidentally forgot our side salad order and we received a complimentary tiramisu as an apology, which was so kind of them. It was absolutely delicious, as were our pizzas. They have two pizza ovens in their open kitchen and the pizzas were in a different league to any others we ate in Vietnam!

Finally, a thank you to Nam, our server, who was extremely pleasant. I wouldn't hesitate to return there.

reviews.review_text:
muriel
Simmozheim, Germany84 contributions
0
Influencer restaurant with maximum acceptable food and poor service
Feb 2026 • Couples
Where should I start? Service: we already had better service at Vapiano - a self-service restaurant. The waiters have made a game of avoiding us with their eyes and not taking our order. Sending people into the waiting room at a restaurant that's 30% full is absolute cheekiness. This was only surpassed by the fact that at a restaurant with twelve waiters for ten tables we had to wait over 1 hour to receive the bill. Same game on other tables. We would have liked to have tried the dessert, but we ran out of time due to the long wait, so that was no longer possible. We were told that the pizza would take over half an hour. No problem we thought, as we had ordered an appetizer, even if we were wondering why with such a staff-guest relationship the food can take so long. We actually waited a long time for our food, but the starter came at the same time as the pizza. The pizza was fine in taste but it was completely muddy until it arrived at our place, which is a feat with a temperature controlled oven. In our long wait, we have watched to the how multiple wrong orders were delivered to the tables. 
The restaurant has a relatively pleasant atmosphere. However, left and right influencer photo shoots are started at their finest with flash lightning storms, which clearly disturbs the atmosphere, especially since you are also placed directly next to other guests, although half the restaurant is empty. 
The two stars exist only out of goodwill and because the food is fine for the price as a European.

Awesome food and service
Jan 2026 • Family
Visited Pizza 4P’s in Hanoi recently and had a fantastic experience, especially for vegetarian diners. The salad was fresh and flavorful, perfectly balancing crisp greens with a light dressing, while the spaghetti stood out with its rich, house-made sauce and al dente pasta—both dishes exceeded expectations.
Staff impressed with their warmth and attentiveness, patiently guiding us through vegetarian options and customizing orders to ensure no meat or non-veg elements were included.
This spot shines for quality Italian-inspired food in Hanoi, with strong vegetarian-friendly choices like those highlighted in their menu, making it ideal for plant-based meals amid the city’s vibrant scene. Highly recommend for anyone seeking reliable veg eats with excellent service.
